sources.note: 2027 Rules for Candidates, General para 1 and Course Selection paras 9-10: scope of study and the types of course not funded
Eligibility page: study at any UK university; points to the Rules and the Course Search tool
Interactive course finder (data from a third-party course database); no downloadable course list

subject_rule: Not limited to a list of subjects, but not fully open either: the 2027 Rules say the awards are tenable at any British university and for study in almost any discipline at graduate level, and then exclude whole types of course (degrees leading to professional qualifications in medicine, dentistry, veterinary science and law, MBA, MSc/MFE Financial Economics, postgraduate diplomas and certificates, part-time, distance-learning and some other formats).
notes: No list of majors exists to record: the Commission publishes funded and unfunded course TYPES, not a catalogue of subjects. The only course-level list is an interactive Course Search tool that cannot be read as a document.
any_subject is left out on purpose: the official wording is 'almost any discipline', with named exclusions, which is neither 'any subject' nor a closed list.

Unfunded courses and types named in the Rules (paras 9-10): second bachelor's degrees; postgraduate diplomas/certificates; professional degrees in medicine, dentistry, veterinary science and law; courses ending in a certificate of completion instead of a degree; distance-learning or largely online degrees; part-time degrees; supervised research with no degree; degrees needing long periods away from the UK including joint degrees with non-UK universities; MBA; MSc/MFE Financial Economics; courses starting in January or at any point other than the start of the academic year; master's courses over 12 months (or 24 for the two-year pathway); two-year pathway master's under 9 months and one-year pathway courses under 10 months. The Oxford MPP is limited to one Marshall Scholar per year and the Oxford MPP + MSc Public Policy Research 1+1 combination is not allowed.
NIH Marshall Scholarships add funding for PhDs in bioscience, medicine and related disciplines at Oxford and Cambridge (Rules para 14).
not_stated: No list of eligible subjects or courses is published as a document; the Course Search tool is the only course-level source.
fetch_problems: The Marshall Course Search page is an interactive tool: its results do not appear in the page text, so no per-course list could be read. It says its data comes from a third-party course database and may be inaccurate, so it would not be used as a list in any case.
